verdict.rationale: Zero's official MCP server exposes a broad slice of the mail UI's core operations. These include listing folders, fetching threads, composing and sending, drafts, deleting, bulk delete and archive, search and label filtering, label create/modify/delete, and AI compose and Q&A. However, nothing documents parity with the UI, and auth is limited to a Better Auth session token, with OAuth only 'coming soon'. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim or a general REST API reference, API coverage of settings, multi-provider account connection and auto-categorization, production-grade OAuth auth, and independent hands-on corroboration.
